fields.name: completed_target_visits
fields.description: Integer counting completed moves above targets while holding the instructed cube, in the required alternating order starting with the robot's right target. Initialize to 0. Increase by one at the decision step immediately following each completed target move; do not increase for pickup, release, or button pressing. Count each completed move once, not each frame showing a highlight. Episode 44 and episode 72 have values [0, 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 4]; episode 53 has [0, 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 6]; episodes 56 and 69 have [0, 0, 1, 2, 2]. e.g. 2
